messages.subject: How to use codex
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I want to run codex for the 2 following analysis:

1. Matched tumor/normal BAM
Is it possible to run Codex with just 2 samples (normal and bam)? If so how can I do it.

2. Tumor BAM only, single sample
Is it possible to run Codex with just one single sample? If so how can I do it.

Thanks for your help.

ALpha

messages.subject: Re: How to use codex
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

CODEX uses a cross-sample normalization procedure to stratify systemic biases and artifacts. Unfortunately, with only one sample or one paired sample, CODEX cannot be applied. You can try ngCGH or Sequenza, which I haven’t used but seems to be able to apply to your scenario.

Cheers,
Yuchao
